title: DermaMNIST Skin Lesion Classification
subtitle: Deep learning comparison for multiclass skin lesion classification
description: Academic comparison of a custom CNN, ImageNet transfer learning, radiology-domain transfer learning and dermatology-oriented pretraining for multiclass skin lesion classification on DermaMNIST.
highlights: Compared six deep learning configurations for multiclass skin lesion classification using DermaMNIST.
Evaluated a custom CNN, ImageNet transfer learning, RadImageNet/RAC initialization and a dermatology-oriented MaxNet/ISIC reference.
Prioritized Macro F1, Balanced Accuracy, Macro Recall and Cohen's Kappa to account for class imbalance.
Used bootstrap-based uncertainty estimates and aggregate visual comparisons to support model interpretation.
Kept raw datasets, clinical images, checkpoints and external pretrained weights out of the public repository.
